The `satisfies` will try to validate lucide icon components against `NavColumnItem["icon"]` which is `React.ComponentType<{ size?: number; strokeWidth?: number; style?: React.CSSProperties }>`. Lucide icons have broader prop types (they accept many more props), so they ARE assignable to that narrower interface in TypeScript's structural typing — this is safe. The `satisfies` keyword checks the value conforms to the type, and since lucide icons accept a superset of those props, they're compatible.
